scenario.tests: Five alternating turns with 25 m legs, shorter than the 40 m 'ahead' distance.
expect: turn 1 (right) gets 'In 40 meters' at along ~20 m and 'now' at ~50 m
turns 2-5 are closer than 40 m apart: the 'ahead' for turn N+1 can only come after turn N is passed; it should say the real distance or go straight to 'now', never announce a turn already behind
every turn gets exactly one 'now' (right, left, right, left, right) in order
no turn skipped, no turn announced twice, at most one say per tick
arrival at the end (along ~200 m); no corrections
